pages.text: $(item)Radiant Tank$() A Radiant Amphora acts as a long distance connection to a specific $(l:blocks/radiant_tank)Radiant Tank$(). You can bind a Radiant Amphora to a Radiant Tank by using the amphora on the desired tank while sneaking. The amphora will become colorized to signify that a connection was made.

While in Fill mode, picking up fluid directly places it into the linked Radiant Tank.$(br2)$(bold)Empty Mode:$() When in Empty mode, fluid is removed from the linked Radiant Tank and placed at the target point.$(br2)You can switch the Radiant Amphora's current mode by left clicking the air.$(br2)$(item)Dispenser$() A Radiant Amphora placed in a Dispenser will attempt to place fluid from its linked tank if the space in front of the Dispenser is empty. If the space in front of the Dispenser has a fluid block, the Amphora will instead attempt to pick it up and send it to its linked tank.
